headline_marked: [[FollowUp Local runs Gemma on your laptop]] to analyze customer chats and predict why they went quiet
headline: FollowUp Local runs Gemma on your laptop to analyze customer chats and predict why they went quiet
summary: A new tool helps small sellers understand stalled conversations by running a Gemma AI model locally, ensuring privacy and providing insights into customer hesitation.
details: FollowUp Local is a new tool designed for solo sellers and tiny shops to analyze customer conversations. It uses a Gemma model running entirely on your own machine to identify why a customer might have gone quiet, helping to revive stalled sales.

The tool processes chat logs, such as those from Instagram DMs or WhatsApp, and provides insights like the stage of the deal, the specific sticking point, and the real underlying concern. This ensures customer privacy as no data leaves the user's computer.

For example, it can connect a customer's past comment about 'peeling labels' to a current hesitation about a sample approval. It also handles multiple languages, including Chinese, and can draft context-aware replies.

Running on a CPU-only Linux box, the 4B Gemma model can analyze a chat in about 19 seconds. This local inference capability makes a low-cost subscription model viable, as there are no per-message cloud costs for the developer.

Built for the DEV Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge, FollowUp Local requires Python 3.9+ and Ollama. It's designed to provide a draft response for the user to review, acknowledging that the model can sometimes misinterpret nuances.

The project emphasizes the importance of open-weight models, which enable this privacy-focused, cost-effective local processing. While closed models might offer slightly more polished replies, the privacy and cost benefits are paramount for the target users.
